evidence: At 360×780, the floated aside is only 77.39 px wide, including 30 px horizontal padding and 2 px border, leaving 45.39 px for text. Its heading breaks "aside" into "asid" / "e" and its paragraph repeatedly breaks words into tiny fragments; the aside becomes 1104.69 px tall. fix: At the phone breakpoint, remove the float and set the aside to width:100% with border-box sizing, placing it above or below the surrounding paragraphs.

evidence: At 360×780, these media elements start at x=51 inside cards whose right border is x=326 and whose content edge is x=309. fix: Constrain these media elements with max-width:100% and box-sizing:border-box so their rendered width fits the 258 px card content area, including the iframe border.
